nodes.label: Next.js agent rules (local docs first)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes vs training data; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code and heed deprecation notices.

nodes.label: Staff-then-public API fallback
nodes.rationale: When a session accessToken exists, staff endpoints are tried first; on failure or without token, public endpoints are used for menu, categories, and tables.

nodes.label: Browser same-origin API proxy
nodes.rationale: Browser uses /api/backend (same origin, no CORS); server-side calls Render remote API directly via NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL or default yadotena.onrender.com.

nodes.label: Role-based dashboard redirect
nodes.rationale: After credentials sign-in, KITCHEN role goes to /dashboard/kitchen; all other staff roles go to /dashboard.

nodes.label: Client payment simulation
nodes.rationale: For takeaway/delivery with non-cash methods, checkout simulates payment with a short delay before placing the order; cash sets paymentStatus PAID; dine-in settles payment later.
